PRE-001.requirement: Current contract and policy must be read before execution or resumption.

LIFE-001.requirement: Every stage follows invoke, verify, persist, verify-persisted, continue.

REC-001.requirement: A recoverable failure transitions to RECOVERING, never directly to BLOCKED.

REC-002.requirement: A single failed tool, provider path, deployment path, write attempt, or intermediate stage is insufficient for BLOCKED.

REC-003.requirement: Before BLOCKED, applicable canonical retry, investigation/bounded repair, authorized fallback, persistence retry/reconciliation, and persisted-state resume paths must be attempted or proven unavailable.

REC-004.requirement: Missing or invalid rebuildable artifacts must be regenerated from authoritative input, verified, persisted, reread, and execution resumed.

RESUME-001.requirement: Resume from the earliest unverified persisted fixture/stage; do not require renewed authorization.

TERM-001.requirement: BLOCKED requires a named policy hard-stop plus evidence and exhausted applicable recovery paths.

TERM-002.requirement: COMPLETE requires all eligible fixtures terminal, aggregate reconciliation, canonical artifacts verified, required commit verified, and intended production deployment verified.

TERM-003.requirement: WAITING requires a genuinely active external process and no useful authorized work remaining until it finishes.

AUTO-001.requirement: A run failure must not disable recurring FIH automation unless the user explicitly requests disabling it or continued execution is itself unsafe/destructive.

EVID-001.requirement: Every PASS/RECOVERING/WAITING/BLOCKED/COMPLETE assertion must name applicable rule IDs and persisted or externally verifiable evidence.
